source: Bundled synthetic evidence. Not a production incident.

evidence.detail: Checkout error rate was 0.2% before deployment and 18.7% after deployment.
Version 2026.09.18.2 changed the Redis connection pool size from 64 to 8.
Checkout requests reported Redis pool acquisition timeouts; 143 requests were waiting.

runbook: Correlate errors with the deployment. Consider reverting the pool-size change. A human must decide. Verify error rate and pool wait time after any real mitigation. This example never performs a deployment.
